**Chain rule.** $(f\circ\gamma)'(0)=f_x(p)\,\gamma_1'(0)+f_y(p)\,\gamma_2'(0)$.

- $\gamma_1'(t)=1$, so $\gamma_1'(0)=1$.
- $\gamma_2'(t)=-0.32(t+2.5)$, so $\gamma_2'(0)=-0.8$.

**Partials at $p$.** Since $f_x=-2(x+2.13)e^{-g}$ and $f_y=-2(y+1.16)e^{-g}$, with $g(p)=2.13^2+1.16^2=5.8825$ and $E=e^{-5.8825}$:

- $f_y(p)=-2.32\,E$

**Combine.**
$$(f\circ\gamma)'(0)=-4.26E+(-2.32E)(-0.8)=(-4.26+1.856)E=-2.404\,E.$$

**Numerics.** $E=e^{-5.8825}\approx 0.00278781$, so
$$(f\circ\gamma)'(0)\approx -2.404\times 0.00278781\approx -0.0067019.$$
